geo.title: Ukraine’s allies meet in Berlin with air defence, energy and financial support on the agenda – Europe live
geo.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has arrived in Berlin to attend a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing. More than 40 international partners are represented at the gathering, which also includes members of the American presidential team. Kyiv’s primary focuses for the discussions are the reinforcement of its air defence systems, energy assistance, and financial backing. Additional topics on the agenda include the diplomatic track, future steps towards ending the conflict, and securing long-term safety guarantees. Zelenskyy stated that his administration is making every effort to ensure Europe is fully involved in the negotiation process to render the meetings productive. Alongside the main summit, the Ukrainian leader has scheduled a series of bilateral discussions with various European partners. These will include talks with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Furthermore, a dedicated format involving the American delegation and European national security advisers is planned for the visit.

geo.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
geo.excerpt: US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping have issued a joint declaration of peace following their first-ever trilateral talks in Shenzhen, China. Held on the sidelines of the APEC summit, the ninety-minute meeting resulted in an agreement that nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought, alongside plans to increase petroleum production and supply. The three leaders also stated their commitment to reforming the United Nations and agreed that institutions like the International Criminal Court must not abuse their jurisdiction. Ahead of the group discussion, Trump held separate bilateral meetings with Putin and Xi, greeting Putin as his friend and describing his relationship with Xi as very special. During the opening remarks, Xi emphasized that positive interaction among major powers is a mandatory requirement, while Putin highlighted a shared interest in ending the war in Ukraine and discussing food and energy security. Trump stated that the leaders have a special responsibility to maintain dialogue and reduce nuclear weapons, while also addressing efforts to prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon. Following the talks, Putin stated that Ukraine and Europe were not yet ready for compromises, while simultaneous drone attacks struck Kyiv. Putin also vowed retaliation for Ukrainian strikes on the Crimean bridge and insisted that realities on the ground in current conflicts must be accepted.

invest.title: Anthropic IPO, AI wealth spawn a new, leaner kind of family office
invest.excerpt: The upcoming Anthropic IPO is projected to create hundreds of centimillionaires and stimulate the establishment of various investment vehicles. Data from the private markets intelligence platform Altss suggests this wealth could generate 15 to 20 new single-family offices over the next three years. Additionally, around 70 households are expected to engage with multifamily offices or outsourced alternatives, alongside a rise in personal investment companies and venture funds. Legal and financial advisors report receiving enquiries from current and former employees and early investors regarding the establishment of their own firms. These newly wealthy professionals generally favour leaner operations that utilise technology and external consultants rather than large in-house teams. Experts note that Anthropic beneficiaries often skew younger than traditional family office principals and tend to focus on hands-on investing and building further wealth rather than preserving multi-generational assets. Because these clients may lack familiarity with a broad range of asset classes, advisors recommend relying on third-party specialists instead of building internal investment functions. Legal professionals highlight alternative models such as founder offices or starter family offices using family limited partnerships to provide tax benefits and flexibility without the high costs and complexity of traditional structures. Consultants also advise against overbuilding infrastructure prematurely, noting that IPO lockups and market volatility mean new fortunes can be unpredictable.
